cards.ex: We need to future-proof our systems against emerging threats.
cards.exUz: Biz yangi tahdidlardan himoya qilish uchun tizimlarimizni kelajakka moslashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyaning kelajakda ham ishlay olishini ta'minlash, eskirishdan saqlash.

cards.ex: The company is undergoing a massive digital transformation.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya katta raqamli o'zgarishlarni boshidan kechirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalarni qo'llash orqali biznes yoki tashkilotni tubdan o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: I accidentally bricked my phone while trying to install a custom ROM.
cards.exUz: Men tasodifan telefonimni maxsus ROM o'rnatmoqchi bo'lganimda buzib qo'ydim.
cards.uzDef: Texnik nosozlik tufayli qurilmani ishlamaydigan holatga keltirib qo'yish.

cards.ex: It's easier than ever to stay connected with family overseas.
cards.exUz: Chet eldagi oila a'zolari bilan aloqada bo'lish har qachongidan ham osonroq.
cards.uzDef: Internet, telefon yoki boshqa texnologiyalar orqali doimiy aloqada bo'lish.

cards.ex: Video conferencing can be difficult due to bandwidth constraints.
cards.exUz: Video konferensiya tarmoq cheklovlari tufayli qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Internet tezligining yetishmasligi, tarmoq o'tkazuvchanligining kamligi.

cards.ex: My email account got hacked last week.
cards.exUz: O'tgan hafta elektron pochtam buzib kirildi.
cards.uzDef: Kompyuter tizimi yoki akkauntga ruxsatsiz kirish.

cards.ex: The Internet of Things is transforming our homes and cities.
cards.exUz: Narsalar interneti uylarimizni va shaharlarimizni o'zgartirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biri bilan bog'langan va ma'lumot almashadigan qurilmalar tarmog'i.

cards.ex: I use remote access to work from home.
cards.exUz: Men uydan ishlash uchun masofadan ulanishdan foydalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa joydan turib kompyuter yoki tarmoqqa ulanish.

cards.ex: The invention of the microchip was a technological leap forward.
cards.exUz: Mikrochipning ixtirosi texnologik sakrash edi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyadagi katta, sezilarli rivojlanish.

cards.ex: The new software has a very intuitive user interface.
cards.exUz: Yangi dastur juda tushunarli foydalanuvchi interfeysiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Dastur yoki qurilma bilan foydalanuvchi o'rtasidagi aloqa usuli.

cards.ex: Data mining can reveal valuable insights about customer behavior.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumot qazish mijozlar xulq-atvori haqida qimmatli ma'lumotlarni ochib berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Katta hajmdagi ma'lumotlardan foydali ma'lumotlarni topish jarayoni.

cards.ex: The pandemic has shown how the digital divide widens inequality.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya raqamli tafovut tengsizlikni qanday kengaytirishini ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalarga ega bo'lganlar va bo'lmaganlar o'rtasidagi farqning ortishi.

cards.ex: I spent hours trying to troubleshoot the network connection.
cards.exUz: Men soatlab tarmoq ulanishidagi nosozlikni bartaraf etishga harakat qildim.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning sababini aniqlash va uni hal qilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Cloud computing has made it easier to collaborate on projects.
cards.exUz: Bulutli hisoblash loyihalarda hamkorlik qilishni osonlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali serverlar, xotira, dasturlar kabi resurslarga kirish.

cards.ex: The smartphone was a disruptive technology that changed the world.
cards.exUz: Smartfon dunyoni o'zgartirgan buzg'unchi texnologiya edi.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud bozorlarni o'zgartiradigan yangi texnologiya.

cards.ex: We need to improve digital literacy skills among older adults.
cards.exUz: Biz keksa avlod orasida raqamli savodxonlik ko'nikmalarini oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan samarali va xavfsiz foydalanish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The kids are glued to their tablets all day.
cards.exUz: Bolalar kun bo'yi planshetlariga yopishib qolishgan.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni jalb qiluvchi narsaga to'liq berilib ketmoq (masalan, ekranga).

cards.ex: I'm out of range here, so I can't make a call.
cards.exUz: Men bu yerda qamrovdan tashqaridaman, shuning uchun qo'ng'iroq qila olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Simsiz aloqa (telefon, Wi-Fi) signali yetarli bo'lmagan joyda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Let's take this discussion offline; it's getting too detailed.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu muhokamani oflaynga olib chiqaylik; u juda batafsil bo'lib ketyapti.
cards.uzDef: Internet yoki tarmoqdan uzib qo'yish, onlayn muhitdan olib tashlash.

cards.ex: The company suffered a major privacy breach last year.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'tgan yili katta maxfiylik buzilishiga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarning ruxsatsiz tarqalishi yoki o'g'irlanishi.

cards.ex: Virtual reality is becoming more immersive and affordable.
cards.exUz: Virtual reallik tobora immersiv va arzonlashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kompyuter tomonidan yaratilgan sun'iy muhit.

cards.ex: Augmented reality apps can overlay digital information onto the real world.
cards.exUz: Kengaytirilgan reallik ilovalari raqamli ma'lumotlarni haqiqiy dunyoga joylashtirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy dunyoga kompyuter tomonidan yaratilgan elementlarni qo'shish.

cards.ex: Investing in the bleeding edge can be risky but also rewarding.
cards.exUz: Eng so'nggi chegaraga sarmoya kiritish xavfli bo'lishi mumkin, lekin ayni paytda foydali hamdir.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyaning eng yangi, hali sinovdan o'tmagan bosqichi.

cards.ex: The company was hit by a zero-day exploit that compromised its data.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaga nol kunlik zaiflik hujum qildi, bu uning ma'lumotlariga zarar yetkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Dasturdagi xavfsizlik zaifligi, tuzatuvchi patch chiqishidan oldin.

cards.ex: Our platform is device agnostic, so it works on any smartphone.
cards.exUz: Bizning platformamiz qurilmaga bog'liq emas, shuning uchun u har qanday smartfonda ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Har xil turdagi qurilmalarda ishlashi mumkin bo'lgan dastur yoki texnologiya.

cards.ex: Geofencing technology can be used for location-based marketing.
cards.exUz: Geofensing texnologiyasi joylashuvga asoslangan marketing uchun ishlatilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Virtual chegara yaratish orqali qurilmalarning joylashuvini aniqlash texnologiyasi.

cards.ex: The tech adoption rate for electric vehicles is increasing rapidly.
cards.exUz: Elektromobillarni texnologiya sifatida qabul qilish darajasi tez sur'atlar bilan o'sib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yangi texnologiyaning aholi yoki bozor tomonidan qabul qilinish tezligi.

cards.ex: The company makes data-driven decisions to improve its performance.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya faoliyatini yaxshilash uchun ma'lumotlarga asoslangan qarorlar qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotlar tahlili asosida qabul qilingan qarorlar.

cards.ex: We use software to automate many of our repetitive tasks.
cards.exUz: Biz takrorlanuvchi vazifalarimizning ko'pini avtomatlashtirish uchun dasturiy ta'minotdan foydalanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Vazifalarni avtomatik tarzda bajarish uchun texnologiyalardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: We are living in the digital age, where technology is constantly evolving.
cards.exUz: Biz raqamli davrda yashayapmiz, bunda texnologiya doimo rivojlanib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Axborot va aloqa texnologiyalarining keng tarqalgan davri.
